## Overview

This 2026-09-15-captured Adyen page is an **iOS integration chooser** for Online banking Czech Republic. It routes readers to iOS Drop-in or Components method guides and to the corresponding Sessions or Advanced base integrations. It contains no iOS request schema, SDK version, payment outcome, or proof of account enablement. See [[adyen]], [[adyen-online-payments]], and the separate CZ/CZK method overview [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-online-banking-czech-republic]].

## Key takeaways

- The page presents **Drop-in** as Adyen's all-in-one UI route and **Components** as the route using `OnlineBankingComponent` in an iOS app. These are navigation choices, not evidence that either implementation has been configured or executed. See raw lines 19–27.
- It says to create the main integration before adding Online banking Czech Republic and lists **iOS Drop-in with Sessions**, **iOS Components with Sessions**, **iOS Drop-in with Advanced**, and **iOS Components with Advanced** base guides. Follow the selected child guide for method-specific fields and redirects; this chooser itself provides none. See raw lines 29–36.
- The linked method overview describes a CZ/CZK bank-redirect payment method. Do not transfer its capability matrix or the iOS child guides' implementation details to this short chooser as if they were stated here. See [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-online-banking-czech-republic]] and raw lines 15–36.
